mentions.name: Intelligrade
mentions.description: A SaaS platform for teachers and schools to create, conduct, and grade exams and tests, with safe exam browser integration to prevent cheating. Grading happens automatically for almost all segment types, with optional AI assistance for free-form text, and an MCP server lets teachers bring their own LLM with fine-grained permission controls. Hosted in the EU, with an option for schools to self-host under license. Currently in a pilot phase with free pro accounts given to schools for feedback.
mentions.problem: Existing exam creation and grading tooling for teachers was dissatisfying.
mentions.source_excerpt: A SaaS for teachers and schools that helps them create, conduct and grade exams and tests (with safe exam browser integration to prevent cheating). Grading happens automatically for almost all segment types, for free form text we have an optional AI integration.
